entry.title: Helicopter Places Hundreds Of Logs To Restore Fish Habitat Near Tiller
entry.summary: A helicopter placed 248 logs along Slick and Boulder creeks near Tiller, restoring approximately four miles of habitat for coho salmon, winter steelhead, lamprey and other native fish.

entry.title: Brown Park Pavilion Now Installed And In Use
entry.summary: The pavilion planned as part of Roseburg’s Brown Park expansion has now been fully installed and is already being used by visitors.

entry.title: Overnight I-5 Ramp Closures Scheduled Near Oakland Through Thursday
entry.summary: Overnight maintenance work will close I-5 ramps at Exits 140 and 142 near Oakland in stages through Thursday morning. The southbound Exit 140 off-ramp closes Tuesday night before work moves to the northbound Exit 142 ramps Wednesday night.

entry.title: Roseburg Identified As Next Location For Private Bridge Housing Development
entry.summary: A private developer has identified Roseburg as its next community for a potential bridge housing development after completing a 176-bed project in Grants Pass. No Roseburg site or formal proposal has been announced.

entry.title: Roseburg Council Rejects Stewart Park Master Plan Bids After Debate Over Project Scope
entry.summary: The Roseburg City Council voted 5-2 to reject all proposals for the Stewart Park Master Plan update. The project will return for new proposals after councilors called for expanding its scope to include more of the riverfront and trail corridor.

entry.title: Roseburg Council Approves Roseburg Disposal Rate Increase
entry.summary: The Roseburg City Council approved an approximately 8% rate increase requested by Roseburg Disposal Company. New garbage and recycling service rates will take effect Jan. 1, 2027.
